title: SCREEN Yourself for Cancer
official: SCREEN Yourself for Cancer (Self-Collection Research Examining Engagement and Navigation)
summary: This randomized controlled trial will evaluate whether evidence-based self-sampling tools improve the cancer screening process among underscreened patients. Participants who are eligible but out-of-date for colorectal cancer screening, cervical cancer screening, or both will be randomized to either usual practice or an intervention that includes mailed self-sampling tools for the appropriate cancer screening test. Primary outcomes include screening initiation (within 12 months of enrollment) and screening completion (within 18 months of enrollment), for each cancer type. Secondary outcomes include repeat screening adherence and receipt of diagnostic resolution following abnormal screening results.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* active patient at Penn State Health Department of Family and Community Medicine
* patients eligible but out-of-date for routine colorectal cancer screening and/or routine cervical cancer screening
* able to read and write in English, Spanish, or Nepali

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients ineligible for routine colorectal and/or cervical cancer screening
* patients up-to-date on routine colorectal and/or cervical cancer screening (as applicable)
* not able to read and write in English, Spanish, or Nepali
